description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Jacobs is a global technology company delivering innovative aviation solutions for a more connected and sustainable world. The Entry Level Software Engineer will develop, test, document, and maintain software supporting military aircraft and mission projects while collaborating with cross-functional engineering teams using Agile practices.
Software engineer building and testing stable applications through requirements, coding, and integration

Responsibilities:
• Contribute to a team of skilled engineers designing, building and maintaining thoroughly tested and stable software using Scaled Agile Framework (SAFE)
• Perform technical tasks to include design, requirements, documentation, code and unit/integration test procedures
• Maintain a collaborative approach with Product Owners, Software Architects, DevOps, Security and UX Engineers
• Be willing to share knowledge through proactive creation of wikis and documentation to help the team
• Participate in daily stand-ups providing status updates and raise any technical issues with the rest of the team
• Contribute to pull request reviews, system demos, planning meetings and retrospectives
• Be able to switch work on different projects as customer and program goals evolve
• Ask smart questions, take risks, and champion new ideas
• Use judgment and originality by interpreting data; planning the work; and refining the methods and techniques being used

Requirements:
• Must be a US Citizen
• Must have the ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance, US DoD Secret or Higher
• Bachelor's degree in computer science or related scientific engineering discipline
• Knowledge in object-orientated computer programming with direct experience using Visual Studio, C#/.Net NodeJS, JavaScript/Typescript
• Experience with common web frameworks and technologies (HTML5. CSS, React, etc.)
• Knowledge of, and skill in applying software engineering principles and practices
• Ability to communicate design processes, ideas, and solutions clearly and effectively to teams and customers
• Ability to effectively articulate technical challenges and solutions
• Work may require occasional travel
• Our team works on a compressed 9/80 schedule
• Hybrid with at least 2 days in office at the Nashua location are required
